sloka: ततो निक्षिप्तभारो ऽहं राघवेण समागत: ।निवेद्य गुरवे राज्यं भजिष्ये गुरुवृत्तिताम् ॥ २.११५.१९॥
transliteration: tato nikṣiptabhāro 'haṁ rāghaveṇa samāgata: ।nivedya gurave rājyaṁ bhajiṣye guruvṛttitām ॥ 2.115.19॥

translations.english: The burden of this kingdom has been cast on me. On reunion with Rama, I shall hand it over to my brother, my guru and shall be engaged in his service.
